name: EH3D-DOCS
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: the hub of the documentation of the EH3D Fabrication Suite: the map of the suite (what each repository is for and whether it exists yet), the architecture rules, and a capability matrix that says what has been run and what has not. It documents three published repositories (EH3D-COMMON, EH3D-CORE-LIBS, EH3D-UPDATER); every other program of the suite is a plan and is listed as one.
